question: Why does promo_code_takes_ten_percent_off fail on CI about one run in four?
facts: On CI it failed in 9 of the last 40 runs.
It has never failed on our laptops, where we run `cargo test promo_code`.
CI runs the whole test suite on 8 threads, in UTC, on shared runners. Our laptops are in Auckland.
When it fails, the total is exactly 100.0: no discount at all.

test.name: promo_code_takes_ten_percent_off
test.failure:
thread 'promo_code_takes_ten_percent_off' panicked at tests/checkout.rs:10:5:
assertion `left == right` failed: SAVE10 should take 10% off
  left: 100.0
 right: 90.0

explanations: Time zone: SAVE10 is valid until the end of today, and today depends on the time zone. CI runs in UTC, our laptops in Auckland, and it only fails on CI.
Race: refund_restores_full_price clears the same global promo table, and cargo runs tests in parallel. Sometimes SAVE10 is gone before checkout reads it.
Float rounding: the total is an f64, and 100.0 times 0.9 is not always exactly 90.0.

knobs.name: threads
knobs.about: how many tests cargo runs at once (RUST_TEST_THREADS)

knobs.name: clock
knobs.about: the UTC time of day when the test runs (set with a fake clock)
